Name: Pale Vanilla Items - Resources Artefacts Food Crops Fish etc
Author: Cridow
Description:
This is an edit of vanilla textures for items in general: food, ingredients, fish, resources, crops, minerals, some craftables, and more. It edits them to be a little brighter, less saturated, and with less contrast, for a pale look.  If you use a recolor that is less saturated than the base game, this mod can help you keep that aesthetic to a point.

With this, you can have a softer, pastel aesthetic in your game across most items and sprites. Keep it high up in the folder names so other replacers can override this one if you intend to use it as a 'base' of sorts.

This mod is not meant to be used all by itself, but [b]you can have it by itself [/b]if you like.

Made for Stardew Valley  1.6. Requires Content Patcher 2.0.0 or later.
